VI. 2. 9</ls>. .²4 Young, fresh. .²5 Modest, shy, bashful. .²6 Diffident, not bold. .²7 Able, clever; शिखीव शारदः <ls>N. 9. 14</ls>. .{@-दः@} .²1 A year. .²2 An autumnal sickness. .²3 Autumnal sunshine. .²4 A kind of kidney-bean. .²5 The Bakula tree. .{@-दी@} .²1 The full-moon day in the month of Āśvina (or Kārtika). .²2 Alstonia Scholaris (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>सातवीण</ns>). .{@-दम्@} .²1 Corn, grain. .²2 The white lotus. .{@-दा@} .²1 A kind of Vīṇā or lute. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Durgā. .²3 Of Sarasvatī; (शरत्काले पुरा यस्मान्नवम्यां बोधिता सुरैः . शारदा सा समाख्याता पीठे लोके च नामतः ..); लिखति यदि गृहीत्वा (लेखनीं) शारदा सार्वकालम् <ls>Śivamahimna 32</ls>. ˚अम्बा (शारदाम्बा) the goddess Sarasvatī.
